item.title: Noah Kahan’s ‘The Great Divide’ Spends Second Week Atop Billboard 200
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to this week's music update. I'm your host, and we're here to dive into the latest Billboard 200 chart. Let's get started!"
[Upbeat music transitions]
Host: "Noah Kahan's album 'The Great Divide' is holding strong at number one for the second week in a row, with 163,000 equivalent album units earned in the US. This makes it the first rock album to spend at least two weeks at the top spot in nearly three years."
[Short music break]
Host: "Meanwhile, Kacey Musgraves is debuting at number three with her new album 'Middle of Nowhere', earning 100,000 equivalent album units. This is her sixth top 10 album, and all of them have debuted in the top five. Her album sales are doing particularly well, with 64,500 units sold, landing her at number one on the Top Album Sales chart."
[Music transitions]
Host: "And if you're a fan of Michael Jackson, you'll be excited to know that his albums are seeing a resurgence in popularity, thanks to the biopic 'Michael'. His album 'Thriller' is rising to number five, and his hits collection 'Number Ones' is jumping to number six."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for this week's music update. Thanks for tuning in, and don't forget to follow us for more chart news and updates. The full Billboard 200 chart will be posted on their website on May 12, so be sure to check it out."
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
